title: Gleanings from the Writings of Baha'u'llah
author: Baha'u'llah
description: Selections from Baha'u'llah's writings on the nature of God, spiritual development and the unity of humanity. These passages introduce the ethical and religious vision at the heart of the Baha'i tradition.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection.
